runnerManager.titlePath: Create & save success toasts > [Notifications] Verify that creating a department emits a created toast.
runnerManager.testTitle: [Notifications] Verify that creating a department emits a created toast.
runnerManager.testDescription: A successful create surfaces the created toast from the MutationCache.

runnerManager.titlePath: Create & save success toasts > [Notifications] Verify that editing a department emits a saved toast.
runnerManager.testTitle: [Notifications] Verify that editing a department emits a saved toast.
runnerManager.testDescription: A successful edit surfaces the saved toast. The form is dirtied through the switch label, because the field id sits on a hidden input.

runnerManager.titlePath: Error toasts > [Notifications] Verify that a board server error emits a toast rather than a native alert.
runnerManager.testTitle: [Notifications] Verify that a board server error emits a toast rather than a native alert.
runnerManager.testDescription: A duplicate board name surfaces an error toast; the native alert() this form used to fire must not appear.
runnerManager.notes: Fixed and passing on dev 2026-08-06. GET /api/boards returns 200 with an empty list on dev, so the old two-branch skip guard always fired; the test now creates its own board via the new data-factory ensureBoard and reuses its name to provoke the unique-name 409.

runnerManager.titlePath: 409 Conflict handling > [Notifications] Verify that a stale department version shows the concurrency banner and no toast.
runnerManager.testTitle: [Notifications] Verify that a stale department version shows the concurrency banner and no toast.
runnerManager.testDescription: PET-64: a stale version renders the shared ConcurrencyErrorBanner and suppresses the error toast. The version bump spreads the full GET response back, because a partial PUT fails enum validation before the bump lands.

runnerManager.titlePath: 409 Conflict handling > [Notifications] Verify that a stale crew version shows the concurrency banner and no toast.
runnerManager.testTitle: [Notifications] Verify that a stale crew version shows the concurrency banner and no toast.
runnerManager.testDescription: Same contract on Crew — regression guard against the old double-notification bug.

runnerManager.titlePath: 409 Conflict handling > [Notifications] Verify that a stale customer version shows the concurrency banner and no toast.
runnerManager.testTitle: [Notifications] Verify that a stale customer version shows the concurrency banner and no toast.
runnerManager.testDescription: Same contract on Customer — regression guard against the no-inline-UI bug.

runnerManager.titlePath: Auth event toasts > [Notifications] Verify that logging out emits a signed-out toast and redirects to login.
runnerManager.testTitle: [Notifications] Verify that logging out emits a signed-out toast and redirects to login.
runnerManager.testDescription: Runs from an unauthenticated context: signing out surfaces the signed-out toast and lands on /login.

runnerManager.titlePath: Auth event toasts > [Notifications] Verify that logging in emits a welcome toast.
runnerManager.testTitle: [Notifications] Verify that logging in emits a welcome toast.
runnerManager.testDescription: Signing in surfaces a welcome toast. The interpolated name is not hardcoded — the message format is what is under test.

runnerManager.titlePath: 401 session-lifecycle discriminator > [Notifications] Verify that a session-expired 401 shows the expiry toast and redirects to login.
runnerManager.testTitle: [Notifications] Verify that a session-expired 401 shows the expiry toast and redirects to login.
runnerManager.testDescription: PET-73: a 401 carrying code=session_expired shows the expiry toast and redirects to /login with a from= return path.

runnerManager.titlePath: 401 session-lifecycle discriminator > [Notifications] Verify that a not-authenticated 401 redirects silently without the expiry toast.
runnerManager.testTitle: [Notifications] Verify that a not-authenticated 401 redirects silently without the expiry toast.
runnerManager.testDescription: PET-73: a 401 carrying code=not_authenticated should redirect without the expiry toast. Marked test.fail — api.ts calls handleAuthExpiry() with no code, and an undefined code is deliberately treated as expired, so the suppressing branch is unreachable.

runnerManager.titlePath: Offline/online toasts > [Notifications] Verify that toggling the context offline and back surfaces toasts.
runnerManager.testTitle: [Notifications] Verify that toggling the context offline and back surfaces toasts.
runnerManager.testDescription: Taking the browser context offline and back surfaces the offline and back-online toasts.

runnerManager.titlePath: Profile avatar — upload > [Profile] Verify that an avatar upload stores server-side and the image refetches.
runnerManager.testTitle: [Profile] Verify that an avatar upload stores server-side and the image refetches.
runnerManager.testDescription: Uploading through the hidden profile file input stores the bytes server-side and the img re-issues its GET with a fresh cache-buster. Skips with a clear reason when the storage backend is unreachable.

runnerManager.titlePath: Profile change-password — 401 mismatch routes to field > [Profile] Verify that a wrong current password shows an inline error and no toast.
runnerManager.testTitle: [Profile] Verify that a wrong current password shows an inline error and no toast.
runnerManager.testDescription: A 401 current-password mismatch should route to an inline field error with no toast. Marked test.fail: api.ts redirects on every non-session/me 401 regardless of meta.suppressStatuses, so this is wired as a regression trip-wire until the app is fixed.

runnerManager.testTitle: [Profile] Verify that a new password under eight characters shows an inline error before submit.
runnerManager.testDescription: A new password under eight characters fails zod validation on blur, before any submit.

runnerManager.testTitle: [Profile] Verify that a mismatched confirm password shows an inline error.
runnerManager.testDescription: A confirm password that differs from the new password fails the refine check on blur.

runnerManager.notes: API fix merged/deployed to dev 2026-08-05 (500->409 on soft-deleted-name collision). The specific literal name BUG-11's repro soft-deleted on dev is permanently stuck (no purge endpoint exists for Validation), so TEST_NAME/TEST_NAME_2 are now run-token-suffixed to never collide with it. mode: 'serial' re-enabled per the file's own docstring.
